{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert `revenue` from string to float: remove commas and cast
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(internal_test_orders)}')"}
